headline: Payment Fees on $1,000 Retainers & Orders
description: Fees on a $1,000 retainer or order across Stripe, PayPal, Square, Shopify, and Wise — percent fees dominate; reverse-price to keep a full $1,000 net.

mainEntity.name: How much does Stripe take on a $1,000 payment?

acceptedAnswer.text: At 2.9% + $0.30 US domestic cards: $29.30 fee, $970.70 net. To receive $1,000 net, charge about $1,030.18.

mainEntity.name: Is Wise cheaper than PayPal for a $1,000 international transfer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often yes on fee transparency, but Wise prices by corridor and amount and is quoted live. Our calculator rows are planning estimates only — generate a Wise quote and compare against PayPal’s commercial + FX schedule for the same currencies.

mainEntity.name: Does the fixed fee still matter at $1,000?

acceptedAnswer.text: Barely for ranking card processors against each other. It still matters when you compare a percent-only schedule (PayPal G&S 2.99%) to percent-plus-fixed (Stripe 2.9% + $0.30): on $1,000, G&S stays slightly ahead on fee dollars in our defaults.
